name: Popover
looksLike: small box that appears next to a button when you click it
floating card with an arrow pointing at its trigger
little panel with no dark background
definition: A small floating panel anchored to the element that opened it. The rest of the page stays usable and there is no dimmed backdrop.
whenToUse: Extra info or options tied to one button
Mini forms such as a rename field

notConfusedWith.difference: Centered, blocks the page, and has a dimmed backdrop.
Slides in from a screen edge instead of sitting next to its trigger.

prompts.short: Add a popover anchored to this button. Close on outside click and Esc.
prompts.detailed: Add a popover anchored below the trigger button with a small arrow, flipping above when there's no room. Close on outside click or Esc, return focus to the trigger, and set aria-expanded on the button.

html: Anchored help text goes here.
reactTailwind: <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-10 mt-2 w-64 rounded-lg border bg-white p-4 shadow-lg">
vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Close on Esc and on outside click
